independence_evidence: The publisher's own site describes it as 'an independent biannual fashion magazine entirely made in Italy', launched 2012 and based in Milan; the team page lists a small in-house masthead and no parent media group is named anywhere on the site.
qualifies_reason: Independent Milan-based print biannual with Issue 29 (Spring-Summer 2026) and Issue 30 (Fall/Winter 2026/27, published October 2026) on sale from the publisher's own shop.
what_it_is: A large-format men's fashion magazine published twice a year from Milan, each issue built around a single theme (the latest is 'The Evernew') and issued with multiple collectable covers. Inside are long fashion editorials shot by an international roster of photographers alongside interviews with actors, designers, artists and athletes, running to well over 400 pages. It suits readers who collect menswear and fashion photography titles and want a seasonal book-like object rather than a newsstand monthly.
